question: Does the harness distinguish a 429 (our arrival rate) from a 529 / vendor-overload (their capacity) and apply different policies? PASS requires: 429 reduces our arrival rate; 529 does NOT reduce program concurrency and instead retries the affected unit while siblings continue.
question_answer: YES: injected 429 halves-then-collapses wave-2 arrival rate (1.0000->0.0625); injected 529 leaves rate 1.0000->1.0000, holds concurrency ceiling 4, retries 8 units, and siblings continue. Mislabelling 529 as 429 is detected by rate drop plus independent ledger recount. SUCCESS:TST-0139
